description: List the 23 divisional (varga) charts available via 'get_divisional_chart'. Returns, for each chart, the 'request_as' value to pass as the 'varga' argument (e.g. 'D-9'), its 'name' (e.g. Navamsa) and 'purpose' (what life area it analyses — marriage, career, children, etc.). Use this to choose the right chart for a question, then call 'get_divisional_chart' with that varga. Takes no birth details. Data only — no interpretation is included.
name: list_divisional_charts
title: Divisional Charts — Catalog
